entries.title: Nehemiah 7:2
segments:
For he; Hananiah. 
 
Power and authority should be committed to those who fear God, and will employ their talents for his cause.

entries.title: Nehemiah 7:3
segments:
Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened; this was designed to guard against enemies. 
 
We should show our trust in God by the proper use of means, and not tempt him by the neglect of them.

entries.title: Nehemiah 7:4
segments: The city was large; the walls, having been built on the old foundations, enclosed more than was inhabited.

entries.title: Nehemiah 7:5
segments:
A register; containing the names of those who came up from Babylon to Judea. 
 
For the remainder of this chapter see the notes on
Every good thought is from above; and while we diligently improve it to the best advantage, God should be acknowledged as the giver of all good, and the glory of all be rendered to him.

entries.title: Nehemiah 7:70
segments: When God, in addition to all his other mercies, gives men a disposition to employ what they have to his glory, it is evidence of his peculiar favor, and should be acknowledged with peculiar gratitude and joy.
